changeSet.author: lifefit-architecture
changeSet.comment: Ticket: LF-0017. Seed Part 3 permissions and grant them through existing roles. No user is inserted. Index review: no new indexes; inserts use UX_Permissions_Code and PK_RolePermissions. Performance note: the catalog insert is a few dozen rows.

rollback.sql: DELETE FROM app.RolePermissions WHERE PermissionId IN (SELECT Id FROM app.Permissions WHERE Code LIKE N'BUSINESS_%' OR Code LIKE N'BRANCH_%' OR Code LIKE N'MEMBER_%' OR Code LIKE N'STAFF_%' OR Code LIKE N'TRAINER_%' OR Code LIKE N'MEMBERSHIP_%' OR Code LIKE N'ATTENDANCE_%' OR Code = N'REPORT_READ'); DELETE FROM app.Permissions WHERE Code IN ( N'BUSINESS_PROFILE_READ', N'BUSINESS_PROFILE_UPDATE', N'BRANCH_READ', N'BRANCH_CREATE', N'BRANCH_UPDATE', N'BRANCH_DELETE', N'MEMBER_READ', N'MEMBER_CREATE', N'MEMBER_UPDATE', N'MEMBER_DELETE', N'STAFF_READ', N'STAFF_CREATE', N'STAFF_UPDATE', N'STAFF_REMOVE', N'TRAINER_READ', N'TRAINER_UPDATE', N'MEMBERSHIP_PLAN_READ', N'MEMBERSHIP_PLAN_MANAGE', N'MEMBERSHIP_READ', N'MEMBERSHIP_CREATE', N'MEMBERSHIP_RENEW', N'MEMBERSHIP_FREEZE', N'MEMBERSHIP_CANCEL', N'ATTENDANCE_READ', N'ATTENDANCE_CHECKIN', N'ATTENDANCE_CHECKOUT', N'REPORT_READ');
